dlna_setup.title: DLNA speakers
dlna_setup.description: After finishing, open Configure for HomeCall. Under DLNA speakers, choose a speaker, play the test sound and confirm you heard it. You can add Alexa later.

music_assistant_setup.title: Music Assistant
music_assistant_setup.description: Set up the Music Assistant integration first, then add players in HomeCall settings. Music Assistant handles music restoration.

cast_setup.title: Google Cast speakers
cast_setup.description: Set up Google Cast in Home Assistant first. After finishing, open HomeCall Configure → Google Cast speakers, add devices and play the test sound. Playback interrupts music and does not automatically restore it. JBL Cast test playback is verified; Nest devices still need testing.
